Modular 16S Satellite BMS ASIC — System Architecture Block Diagram
BATTERY STACK — 16 CELLS IN SERIES (V1 – V16)
Li-Ion / LiFePO4 · 17 sense wires (one tap per cell + GND reference)
Max cell voltage 4.25 V · Stack up to 68 V (16S)
OVP trip at 4.25 V per cell
Placed near Trip pad on die
[ The Radio · Noisy digital — placed far from AFE-I ]
CAN FD · SMBus · I²C · UART · ISO 26262 compliant
LDO regulators · sleep FSM · clock gating · wake-on-fault · POR / WDT
NET LEGEND — Signal Definitions & Routing Intent
Digitized V/T samples: AFE-I → DFP, HAE-SOC, A-BAL
Zero-latency hard-fault → EXT pad (bypasses all logic)
State of Charge / Health — HAE-SOC → A-BAL (energy-aware)
Floor-plan: AFE-I top die (sense pads, quiet zone) · D-COMM far from AFE-I (noisy digital) · DFP near Trip pad · P-MGMT centre-bottom
